Other Terms & Conditions: (i) Payment Terms: 100% within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of materi al at MSF. Spot payment/ Advance payment will not be admissible. (ii) LD Clause: Delivery must be completed within stipulated Delivery Period/ Job Completion . If the Seller fails to deliver the material within stipulated Delivery P eriod/ Job Completion, MSF shall be entitled to recover from the Seller liquidated damages, by way of penalty a sum of 0.5% per week of delay or part thereof, su bject to a maximum of 10% as our claim towards liquidated damages on the un delivered part of the order. The LD will be charged on the basic cost. Imposition, recovery or settlement of this LD shall not affect Buyer’s right to performance, c ompensation and termination of the agreement. However no LD will be imposed if the delay is not attributable to the firm. (iii) Bidders shall offer their quotes only on firm and fixed basis. Evaluation of th e bid shall be made on the basis of the seller's offer price inclusive of GST/IGST

with delivery charges (including transportation, loading unloading and local levi es) etc. Seller must quote their offer price inclusive of all taxes & charges like G ST/IGST with delivery charges (including transportation, loading unloading and l ocal levies) etc. at the consignee destination. (iv) The items should have standard Guarantee/Warranty for period of 01 year fr om the date of final acceptance for any defects. In case of defective Stores whi ch need to be re-supplied To & Fro freight, insurance charges if any required for replacement have to be paid by the seller. Warranty calls needs to be attended within 07 days. The guarantee period would be extended by equivalent period f or which the material is not available for the repairable parts. (v) Participating firms must submit a declaration duly filled, signed & stamped ( as per attached format) that they comply with all terms and conditions of GeM Bid. (vi) As per MSE policy “If the bidder wants to avail the purchase preference, the bidder must be a manufacturer of the offered products for supply of goods”. In t his regards bidder has to submit the declaration against manufacturer of the off ered products / goods in firm’s letter head duly signed & stamped and also sub mit the factory license and Plant & Machinery details to verify the same. (Disclai mer: If any false declaration found in this regards, the legal action deemed fit wi ll be taken as per the Govt. Rule). (vii) Other terms & conditions to be followed as per YIL SPM-2024. (viii) The clauses of these Buyer Added Terms & Conditions i.e. ATC will superse de the relevant clauses of GeM GTC and other relevant clauses and T&Cs in the bid documents. . 9.
